name: Crowd Circuit
blurb: A thousand runners, one circuit. Cross alternating checkpoint lines to score in sixty-second rounds.

landing.pitch: Find your lane. Run with the crowd.
landing.about: Shuttle between the amber and mint lines. Each crossing scores a point, then your target switches sides. Everyone shares one long arena; nearby runners stay in view.

controls.phone: Drag anywhere on the arena to run.
controls.computer: WASD or arrow keys to run.

howToPlay: Cross the mint line on your right.
Turn and cross the amber line on your left.
Keep shuttling until the sixty-second round ends.

credits.role: Game, canvas art and synthesized checkpoint tone
credits.name: Shop Trial
